extension.summary: Movies and series for Lucent, with AIOStreams and Trakt
Films en series voor Lucent, met AIOStreams en Trakt
extension.description: Browse with TMDB, play through your own AIOStreams address and keep your progress on Trakt. Works without Seren.
Bladeren met TMDB, afspelen via je eigen AIOStreams-adres en je voortgang bijhouden op Trakt. Werkt zonder Seren.
extension.news: 0.9.0: Streaming services: a list of the services in your country, and per service what it offers, newest first (films, series or both). Country setting under Connections (empty = automatic). Lists used as Home rows no longer end with a "next page" item. 0.8.0: Easynews (username and password) and TorBox (API key) as sources next to AIOStreams. TorBox only shows what it already has, so it can stream right away; the link is made when you press play. A dead link moves on to the next source. 0.7.0 and earlier: first versions of Lucent Video - films and series from TMDB, playback through your own AIOStreams address, filters and order of sources, Trakt and SIMKL (continue watching, next episodes, watchlist, lists, scrobbling), resume and next episode, Lucent-style windows. Not yet tested with real accounts: feedback welcome.
